نتنازل (form VI)
# نَتَنَازَلُ (natanāzalu) /na.ta.naː.za.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَازَلَ (tanāzala)
# نَتَنَازَلَ (natanāzala) /na.ta.naː.za.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَازَلَ (tanāzala)
# نَتَنَازَلْ (natanāzal) /na.ta.naː.zal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَازَلَ (tanāzala)
